description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction class, testing JSON parsing, message formatting, and JavaScript dispatch functions within an Android application.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIActionTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for extracting action names, formatting messages, and generating JavaScript code for UI actions.

methods.name: extractActionNameAcceptsNameOrAction
methods.description: Tests that the extractActionName method correctly retrieves 'name' or 'action' from JSON objects, including fallback on empty name.

methods.name: formatAgentMessageMatchesSharedSpec
methods.description: Verifies that the message formatting function produces the expected string based on input parameters.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2uiStatusIsStable
methods.description: Checks the JavaScript code generated for a successful status update with no errors.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2uiStatusQuotesControlCharacters
methods.description: Ensures that special characters in IDs and error messages are properly escaped in the generated JavaScript code.
